prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_DWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='NaiveSeasonal', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ONLY_DWT_catboost dominates with perfect trend correlation (1.0) and lowest RMSE (33.49), while NaiveSeasonal captures seasonality best (0.569). High spectral entropy (0.929) and unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.25) indicate noisy series requiring robust combination methods like median/trimmed_mean over weighted stacking.
